route.name: Right (Fruitport quals): preloads, corner, under the HIVE, LEFT volley, wall FLOWER, park

Right (Fruitport quals): preloads, corne.note: RoboDux, from video (Fruitport Q, 22 Nov 2026 review), red frame, times after PLAY (clips' PLAY at 3.0 s). Path read every 0.5-1.5 s against a field grid projected from the four FLOWER posts and the corners (homography, 3-14 px fit error; +-6 in near, +-8-10 in at the far end). Traced in Q-1 (blue, converted by the half-turn), Q-10 (blue) and Q-33 (red); Q-19 (blue) seen from the wall FLOWER on and agrees. Start (51-57, 4-12) at the audience end, beside our RIGHT_START. Preloads at the AUDIENCE CELL from the start; this entry's 1.8 s / 1.4 s are M-3's (first ball ~1.8 s, last ~3.2 s); in the quals the volley times are CAN'T TELL (Q-10: the AUDIENCE CELL swung ~5.5 s and settled ~6.5 s). Then the audience-wall corner (12-23, 4-10) from ~5.5 to ~10 s (Q-1, Q-10, Q-33 at (13, 7)); then UNDER the HIVE, not up the wall-side lane as at Kentwood: (55, 27) at 11 s, (62-68, 55-67) at 12 s, at the scoring end (48-58, 112-122), beside our LEFT_AUTO_HIVE, from ~13 to ~19.5 s; the volley there at the LEFT CELL is a placeholder (balls seen in the air near the far CELLs ~15 s in Q-10; first/last ball CAN'T TELL). Back down the wall side ((34, 99) at 20 s in Q-1, (45, 71) at 21 s in Q-10) to the red-wall FLOWER (14-31, 43-52) ~21-24 s, then parked in the LOADING ZONE at (9-21, 89-96) by ~26-28 s (Q-1 26-28 s, Q-10 27 s, Q-33 27 s, Q-19 (11-12, 84-91)). FTCScout: LEAVE and AUTO PARK in all five quals; alliance AUTO TIP 1 in Q-1, Q-10, Q-19, Q-33 (the preloads; so the LEFT volley did not finish a TIP), 2 in Q-44. Q-44 (red) is a different route: preloads ~2.8-3.6 s, corner ~5-10 s, red-wall side ~13-16 s, the scoring end ~19-24 s (where: CAN'T TELL), parked ~(8, 84) by ~26 s; its LEFT CELL tipped ~26-28 s (who: CAN'T TELL). The same Auto as Kentwood's main entry in its pieces and order (preloads, corner, LEFT volley, wall FLOWER, park), with the under-HIVE road of Kentwood Q-15. Heading CAN'T TELL after the start (faces 90 at the start, red '10255' panel toward the camera); later h values are placeholders.
